_about: Quotes verified against the Elden Ring wikis (Fextralife + Fandom). Times are seconds into the edit (song from 0:34.06). 'shot' holds one image for the whole line. To add real voice lines, put clips in examples/elden_ring/voices/ and add "audio": "voices/<file>" to an entry (optional "gain", "audio_at"). Voice clips: 'source' + 'clip' [start,end] are hand-checked myinstants.com clips; run `python getvoices.py <this file>` to fetch them into voices/ (gitignored). Lines without a clip stay text-only.

captions.speaker: White Mask Varré
captions.text: Tarnished, are we? Unfortunately for you, however, you are maidenless.

captions.speaker: Margit, the Fell Omen
captions.text: Foul Tarnished, in search of the Elden Ring.

captions.speaker: Godrick the Grafted
captions.text: …Well. A lowly Tarnished, playing as a lord.

captions.speaker: Ranni the Witch
captions.text: A pleasure to meet thee, Tarnished. I am the witch Renna.

captions.speaker: Morgott, the Omen King
captions.text: Graceless Tarnished. What is thy business with these thrones?

captions.speaker: Maliketh, the Black Blade
captions.text: Witless Tarnished… Why covet Destined Death?

captions.speaker: Miquella
captions.text: Tarnished one. Aspiring Lord of the old order.

captions.speaker: Hoarah Loux
captions.text: Brave Tarnished. Thy strength befits a crown.
